Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study contains multiple MS approaches: 1) Bottom-up LC-MS/MS for protein identification from gel bands (DDA), 2) Intact mass measurement (Top-down/Protein MS), and 3) HDX-MS. The PRIDE metadata and the 'In-gel digestion' section describe a standard bottom-up DDA workflow. While PRIDE metadata lists 'Top-down proteomics' as an experiment type, the detailed methods for the Orbitrap Fusion Lumos runs describe trypsin digestion and peptide separation, which is bottom-up. The intact mass measurements were performed on a separate instrument (Synapt G2).
